title: Bulk-Calibrated Credal Ambiguity Sets: Fast, Tractable Decision Making under Out-of-Sample Contamination
findings: The proposed LV-Group method achieved the highest worst-group accuracy on the CivilComments classification task, which involves identity subgroups including religious ones (Christian, Muslim). This indicates improved performance and fairness for the most challenging subgroups compared to baseline methods like ERM and GroupDRO.
